question: Test whether terminal recorder state can retain and actuate the first directed C06 balance.

conditional bounded logical recorder; amplitude backreaction open

assumptions: SA-TIME-018 bounded abstract Fire/Ack contract with width w at least one and no wrap.
Start Ready at R=2^w-1 and h=0, with positive odd stock and empty amplitude records.
Reserve final Fire exclusively for the first upward C06 balance and commit the port change on that event.
Declared v0.16 parity-orthogonal record port and metric adjoint. No reset before handoff.

calculation_steps: Check selective stock and actuator timing

result.scope: Under the bounded counter contract, the last reserved Fire supplies persistent completion. An unrestricted recorder accepts an unrelated Fire into the same terminal state and can falsely hold 1/50. The amplitude-to-Fire authorization and selective actuator are declared hypotheses.

counterexamples_and_failures: Unreserved final Fire falsely arms the actuator
Pending-only output clears at ordinary Ack
Finite delay can corrupt exact half-transfer
limitations: Source law connecting balance to authorized Fire and selective hold is open
next_discriminant: Find a source-admitted rule excluding unrelated Fire and atomically coupling the directed guard to the recorder and port before Stage 2.
